name: SD: an arable farm that wears out its soil (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A farm's weekly records over twenty years: the soil nitrogen the agronomist samples, the crop standing in the fields, and the grain in the barn. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-farm-soil/truth.model.json, including a stock the records do not show), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests effects: soil nitrogen speeds up the crop's growth with diminishing returns, and harvesting draws the nitrogen down (a co-flow), so a big harvest slows the next one: a balancing loop closed by the effect. Dry and wet years come unannounced; crop rotation, which restores the soil faster, is announced.
